scoring_justification: Exponents and magnetization are compared to paper-reported values; recomputing from raw simulation intermediate is infeasible without altering the output contract.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference values for effective exponents and expected hysteresis conditions
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper: η=0.25±0.03, γ=1.7±0.2 (Eq. 1); magnetization hysteresis described in Fig. 2 inset with values derived from typical sample behavior; reference solve.sh writes 0.90,0.05,0.83,0.05.
hidden_assets.generation_method: derived from paper numerical results and qualitative hysteresis description; tolerances chosen to absorb legitimate Monte Carlo run-to-run spread while excluding a generic constant guess.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the actual reported effective exponents and a physically realistic hysteresis loop; the values align with the paper's claim and the oracle check.

outputs.description: Reproduced effective critical exponents and hysteresis magnetization values; compared to the paper's reported numbers for consistency.

steps.description: Verify effective exponents and magnetization hysteresis against paper reference
